status: Prospective experiment, no scientific outcomes supplied
profile: SLE-AE1-n5-v1, fixed N=4, ordinary symbol IDs0..29, END30 and UP31 reserved
grammar: Q=01+010+r(3 information bits followed by syntax0)+four words(each5 information bits followed by syntax0)+END111100. A=the first r complete6-bit words, then model-generated external S. END is not echoed.
bank: 900 fixed payloads. First two IDs enumerate every ordered pair a,b in0..29. Last two IDs are a frozen seeded random suffix. Payload and order remain identical when r changes. All900 are taught; no heldout. This is not all30^4 possible four-word questions.
training: Three fresh seeds101/202/303, unchanged dense tanh P030 Model/Adam.003, fixed L80/H64/10499 parameters. Phase1 all900 r1 Q,6300 labelled targets per epoch. Phase2 all1800 Q, r1 andr2 from the same bank,18000 targets per epoch. Each phase prefreezes40 independent full target-pair permutations perseed. Teachers feed correct answer prefixes; tests greedily feed own generated prefixes. No decoded features, cursor or forcedSTOP enters the model.
progression: At each complete epoch end, probe every currently taught Q. A full A plus S must be exact on all Q. Two consecutive perfect epochs advance phase1 or finish phase2. Any miss resets streak. Max40epochs perphase. A student failing phase1 stops without seeing any r2 targets; do not silently advance. Phase2 rehearses r1 and r2, and both must be perfect for completion. No score-dependent extra epochs, replacement seeds, best-checkpoint selection or schedule regeneration.
reporting: Record every epoch score, full state, loss/prediction digest, stage/streak/stop decisions, first observed perfect and stable completion epochs. Freeze full initial states and all courses before training. All failures remain. Final teacher-prefix diagnostics only on actually taught r values. Inference/replay/engineering/audit costs separate. No unseenr3/r4 probes this round.
scope: Finite-bank learning of parameterized prefix Echo and retention when r2 is introduced. No claim of blind/generalized copying or isolated causal improvement over older AE1, whose curriculum and data differ. Full-domain numeric8 Echo/Neg is a separate incompatible profile; no old weights or Neg code mixing.
